message: release builds do not check integer overflow: set `overflow-checks = true` under `[profile.release]` in the workspace Cargo.toml, with no override setting it to false
rule: Release builds check integer overflow
why: Integer overflow panics in debug builds but silently wraps in release builds unless `overflow-checks` is on. The arithmetic lints cover the source tauten scans; this setting covers everything compiled in the workspace, dependencies included. The decision is proved (tauten_check_kernel::manifest::hardening): a setting tauten cannot read is never clean. Limits: it covers binaries built from this workspace, not downstream users of a library crate (their own profile decides), and an environment override (`CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OVERFLOW_CHECKS`) or a Cargo config outside the workspace (for example `~/.cargo/config.toml`) at build time is not seen.
fix: Add `overflow-checks = true` under `[profile.release]` in the workspace Cargo.toml (`cargo tauten init --write` does), and remove any `[profile.release.package.<name>]` or `.cargo/config.toml` entry that sets it to false.

message: manifest sets `clippy::cast_possible_truncation` to `warn`; the profile keeps it blocking
rule: Manifest lint table loosens the profile
why: `[lints]` entries that allow or warn profile lints have no effect under `cargo tauten check` but mislead readers and plain `cargo clippy` runs.
fix: Remove the entry from `[lints]` / `[workspace.lints]`.

message: file-level `#![allow(clippy::expect_used)]`: use `expect(clippy::expect_used, reason = "...")` on the item that needs it; for a module compiled into several targets (shared test helpers), put it on the `mod` declaration in each target where the lint fires
rule: Lint exceptions must be `#[expect]` with a reason
why: `#[allow]` silently outlives the code it excused. `#[expect(lint, reason = "...")]` documents why and fails once the exception is no longer needed.
fix: Replace `#[allow(x)]` with `#[expect(x, reason = "why this is safe here")]` on the smallest item possible, or fix the code. A module compiled into several targets (helpers under `tests/` declared with `mod support;` by several test files) cannot carry an inner `#![expect]`: it is unfulfilled in every target where the lint does not fire. For `dead_code` only, it may carry `#![allow(dead_code, reason = "...")]`. Otherwise put `#[expect(x, reason = "...")]` on the `mod` declaration in exactly the targets where it fires, or remove the sharing: one integration-test target per crate (`tests/it/main.rs` with the tests as modules), or a support crate used as a dev-dependency.

message: crate-wide exception for `clippy::expect_used` (TAU-P001)
rule: No crate-wide exceptions to profile lints
why: A crate-level `#![expect(...)]` or `#![allow(...)]` of a profile lint switches the rule off for the whole crate.
fix: Move the exception to the single item that needs it, with a reason.

fix: Replace `#[allow(x)]` with `#[expect(x, reason = "why this is safe here")]` on the smallest item possible, or fix the code. A module compiled into several targets (helpers under `tests/` declared with `mod support;` by several test files) cannot carry an inner `#![expect]`: it is unfulfilled in every target where the lint does not fire. For `dead_code` only, it may carry `#![allow(dead_code, reason = "...")]`. Otherwise put `#[expect(x, reason = "...")]` on the `mod` declaration in exactly the targets where it fires, or remove the sharing: one integration-test target per crate (`tests/it/main.rs` with the tests as modules), or a support crate used as a dev-dependency.

message: crate-wide exception for `clippy::arithmetic_side_effects` (TAU-N001)
rule: No crate-wide exceptions to profile lints
why: A crate-level `#![expect(...)]` or `#![allow(...)]` of a profile lint switches the rule off for the whole crate.
fix: Move the exception to the single item that needs it, with a reason.

message: manifest sets `clippy::cast_possible_truncation` to `warn`; the profile keeps it blocking
rule: Manifest lint table loosens the profile
why: `[lints]` entries that allow or warn profile lints have no effect under `cargo tauten check` but mislead readers and plain `cargo clippy` runs.
fix: Remove the entry from `[lints]` / `[workspace.lints]`.
